page_title: STR 2-3 HAV | Strasbourg v Le Havre 17/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+12' That's the end of the match.
90+10' Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg) is the one who receives a yellow card.
90+10' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) is going to take the penalty!
90+9' 2 - 3 GOAL! That’s a perfect strike from the spot by Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) high into the middle of the goal, giving goalkeeper Djordje Petrovic no chance!
90+8' Loic Nego (Le Havre) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
90+7' Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) now unnecessarily receives yet another yellow card, which means only one thing for him: an early bath.
90+5' Poor challenge! Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg) is penalised for tripping and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. That is a penalty kick for Le Havre.
90+5' The yellow card goes to Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg).
90+3' Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+2' Le Havre seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' The referee signals a substitution. Rassoul Ndiaye (Le Havre) is brought on as a substitute for Josue Casimir.
88' Didier Digard has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Antoine Joujou (Le Havre) replacing Yassine Kechta.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Felix Lemarechal trots off the pitch and is replaced by Andrew Omobamidele (Strasbourg).
86' Josue Casimir (Le Havre) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.

85' Sebastian Nanasi plays a short pass through to Habib Diarra (Strasbourg) inside the box, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Le Havre.
82' The referee gives a yellow card to Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg).
82' Strasbourg quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
82' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) trips an opposition player and Jerome Brisard signals a foul. Strasbourg have a free kick.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Abdoul Ouattara (Strasbourg) replaces Sekou Mara.
78' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Josue Casimir (Le Havre), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
77' Le Havre enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
73' Liam Rosenior prepares a substitution. Dilane Bakwa is replaced by Samuel Amo-Ameyaw (Strasbourg).
73' That will be all from Valentin Barco who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Habib Diarra (Strasbourg).
73' Substitution. Mahamadou Diawara (Le Havre) replaces Fode Ballo-Toure.
70' 2 - 2 It's in the back of the net! Issa Soumare plays it into the box, and Josue Casimir (Le Havre) gets on the end of the cross to put it into the bottom left corner. 2:2.
68' The Le Havre players can't believe it after the referee disallows the goal after the intervention of the VAR!
67' Wait! The referee has now indicated he wants to check if the goal for Le Havre can stand using VAR.
66' Goal! Koka (Le Havre) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 2:2.
64' A substitution has been made. Andre Ayew is replaced by Timothee Pembele (Le Havre).
63' Didier Digard decides to make a substitution. Arouna Sangante will be replaced by Koka (Le Havre).

61' Ambitious effort from Diego Moreira (Strasbourg). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Le Havre will have a goal kick.
59' The game is interrupted now, Arouna Sangante (Le Havre) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
57' Le Havre try to maintain the tempo of the game by taking a quick free kick.
57' A player from Strasbourg commits a rough challenge. Jerome Brisard blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick is awarded to Le Havre.
57' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mathieu Gorgelin, who smothers the ball.
53' 2 - 1 Goal! Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:1.
50' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' A clumsy foul by Ismael Doukoure (Strasbourg) and Jerome Brisard blows his whistle. Le Havre are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
47' The Strasbourg players are exchanging some short passes.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Loic Nego (Le Havre) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
45+2' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
43' 1 - 1 Goal! Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Djordje Petrovic.
43' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
43' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty to Le Havre!
42' The referee isn't 100% sure if it's a penalty to Le Havre, he's going to review using VAR.

42' Valentin Barco (Strasbourg) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! The referee gives a penalty to Le Havre after a quick talk with the linesman, who had apparently seen the situation from a better perspective.
40' The corner kick from Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
38' Gautier Lloris (Le Havre) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
37' Fode Ballo-Toure (Le Havre) is able to continue to play.
36' Fode Ballo-Toure (Le Havre) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
33' Sebastian Nanasi (Strasbourg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
33' Strasbourg take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
30' Yassine Kechta (Le Havre) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
29' The corner is swung in but Le Havre can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
28' Felix Lemarechal (Strasbourg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared. Strasbourg force a corner. They send men into the box.
27' Fode Ballo-Toure (Le Havre) jumps into a tackle and Jerome Brisard signals a foul.
26' The linesman signals a throw-in for Le Havre.
22' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Le Havre, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
20' 1 - 0 Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) wins himself some space inside the box after the corner kick and finishes into the top of the net.
19' Fode Ballo-Toure (Le Havre) commits a foul after bringing down his opponent with a slide tackle.
19' Strasbourg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

16' Sekou Mara (Strasbourg) receives a slide-rule pass inside the box and has just the keeper to beat. His shot towards the middle of the goal lacks power and Mathieu Gorgelin easily makes the save. It will be a corner kick for Strasbourg.
15' The percentage of ball possession is – 49:51.
12' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

10' Issa Soumare (Le Havre) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jerome Brisard with no other option than to blow for a foul.
8' Dilane Bakwa (Strasbourg) makes a slide tackle, but referee Jerome Brisard blows for a foul.
7' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
6' Andrey Santos (Strasbourg) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
6' Guela Doue (Strasbourg) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
4' Abdoulaye Toure (Le Havre) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
3' Referee Jerome Brisard sees the trip by Guela Doue (Strasbourg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Strasbourg will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jerome Brisard.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
